With Opira AI, you can secure your intelligence with an offline-first AI ecosystem that transforms into a complete knowledge channel with role-based governance. This means you can query sensitive documents, compare models, and automate AI workflows without sending a single byte to the cloud.

Opira AI's offline LLM platform eliminates data leakage risk by keeping your sensitive documents and proprietary code within your controlled environment. Every query is processed entirely on-premise, ensuring that your data never leaves your network.

Yes, you can compare different LLM models side-by-side in real-time using Opira AI's multi-model AI chat hub. This allows you to evaluate and choose the best model for your specific use case.

Can I deploy Opira AI as an internal microservice?

Yes, you can deploy Opira AI as an internal microservice using our LLM-as-a-Service (Internal API) feature. This allows your applications to access the power of Opira AI without sending sensitive data to the cloud.
How does Opira AI's offline LLM platform address internet dependency?

Opira AI's offline LLM platform is designed to be completely offline, allowing you to continue critical workflows and field teams' productivity even when connectivity drops. This ensures that your organization can operate uninterrupted.
How does Opira AI's offline LLM platform handle knowledge-grounded AI?

Opira AI's offline LLM platform uses intelligent document vectorization with Retrieval-Augmented Generation directly on your infrastructure. This allows you to query PDFs, SOPs, and contracts with source attribution and zero external calls.
